title: KHR_character_expression_texture KHR_character_expression Extension
description: glTF extension that extends KHR_character_expression to specify texture-based expression animations.

channels.description: Array of animation channel indices that drive texture-based expressions.

items.description: Index of an animation channel in the expression's selected animation.
items.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `channels` array of the animation selected by the containing expression entry's `animation` property.
